name: Banh it la gai
summary: Bánh ít lá gai is glutinous rice, ramie leaf, mung bean, and sugar, round or a cylinder, with a dark green skin and a yellow mung-bean filling.
origin: A Da Nang cake, sold with bánh su sê.
howToEat: Eat the cake as it is, green skin and yellow filling.
where: In Da Nang, beside bánh su sê.
seoTitle: Banh it la gai — ramie-leaf cake
seoDescription: Bánh ít lá gai is glutinous rice, ramie leaf, mung bean, and sugar, with a dark green skin and a yellow mung-bean filling.
